---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or new capability
title: '[Feature]: '
labels: enhancement
---

### Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear description of the problem. E.g. "I'm frustrated when […] because […]"

### Describe the solution you'd like
What you want to happen, and how it should behave. If it involves a player behavior, name the competitor app that does it well (Infuse, Nova, VLC, …) - a screenshot or screen recording helps a lot.

### Describe alternatives you've considered
Other ways to solve the problem, or settings/workarounds you already tried.

### Context
- App version + build: Settings → About
- Platform: Android / iOS / Android TV
- Anything else useful (library setup, typical files, network sources you use)

### Note on iOS premium features
Some advanced features on iOS (spatial audio, night mode, video upscaling) are part of the premium subscription - if your request falls in that area, say so and we'll factor it in.
